title: Write the field repository into a form
summary: Brings the persistent fields of a text DFM, and their declarations in its unit, in line with the field repository as a change set, dry run by default
intro: Read this when a form should follow the field repository. drag-lint repo write-dfm prints the property changes of existing persistent fields and, for a field selection, the fields to add or remove; --apply or --select writes them with a backup, and a --select file must hold the plan id of the dry run its ids are from. Every byte outside a change stays the same, the new text is checked by Delphi's own reader before it is written, and a binary DFM is refused.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint repo write-dfm --dfm <file.dfm>[;...] [--dataset <Name> [--names <FIELD,...>|all]] --direction repo-to-dfm (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply | --select <id file>] [--dry-run] [--json]
help: drag-lint repo write-dfm      --dfm <file.dfm>[;...] [--dataset <Name> [--names <FIELD,...>|all]] --direction repo-to-dfm (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply | --select <id file>] [--dry-run] [--json]   (the property changes that bring the persistent fields of a text DFM in line with the repository, and with --names the fields of one dataset to add or remove, declarations in the unit included; every byte outside a change stays, the new text is checked by Delphi's own reader first, each changed file gets a backup; what cannot be settled is BLOCKED with the reason; the repository is only read; no --apply = dry run; a --select file needs the # plan line of its dry run; a binary DFM is refused; exit 1 plan / write failure or a changed plan, 2 usage)

questions.ask: How do I bring the fields of a form in line with the repository?
How do I add every repository field of a table to a dataset as persistent fields?
